mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the monthly CPIAUCSL inflation index above 0.3% triggers a risk premium adjustment that drives positive S&P 500 20-day forward returns.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL crosses above 0.3% in the current month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not statistically positive (p > 0.05) during confirmed inflation spikes above 0.3%, or CPIAUCSL does not exceed 0.3% in the trigger month.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly rise in PAYEMS employment exceeds 10,000 jobs, indicating stronger labor market absorption, which precedes a positive S&P 500 60-day forward return.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative or flat during confirmed employment gains above 10,000, or PAYEMS does not exceed prior month by more than 10,000 in the trigger window.

mechanism_narrative: A consecutive monthly decline in RSAFS industrial production of at least two consecutive months signals weakening demand, which is associated with negative S&P 20-day forward returns.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS decreases for two consecutive months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns remain positive despite two consecutive months of RSAFS declines, or the pattern is not detected in the data.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly drop in INDPRO manufacturing index below 100 (2017=base) accompanied by a rise in FEDFUNDS suggests supply-side constraints and higher risk premia, driving negative 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive during confirmed INDPRO < 100 and rising FEDFUNDS, or the interaction is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When FEDFUNDS remains above 4.5% for three consecutive months, the S&P 60-day forward return is expected to be negative due to persistent high rates compressing equity valuations.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive during the three-month high-rate period, or FEDFUNDS never exceeds 4.5% in the window.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden drop in UNRATE below 3% signals labor market slack, which precedes a positive 5-day S&P 500 forward return as investors anticipate rate cuts.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not positive during confirmed UNRATE < 3%, or the effect is not statistically detectable (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent monthly increases in GDPC1 (consumer demand) and HOUST (housing) above their 2022 Q4 averages predict a positive 20-day S&P 500 forward return as confidence rebounds.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns remain negative during the dual proxy rebound, or the interaction is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A regime shift to a supply-constrained environment (indicated by two consecutive months of INDPRO < 102) is associated with a negative 60-day S&P 500 forward return as investors price in production bottlenecks.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive during the supply-constrained regime, or the pattern is not detected in the data.
